title: Prime Access Trailer/Nidus
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - "We cast our shining child adrift on strange seas. For with time, these starless currents black as mourning will work a sea-change. And if, one grisly dawn, the skies should hurl you, herald-like, back to Earth, remind us, foundling, of what we immaculate ones have lost.
What succulent richness disease's kiss may bring.
